tasks.name: 创建笔记模型
创建笔记API
创建笔记前端页面
实现笔记搜索功能
设置项目结构和配置

T1.implementation_approach: Define a Note model with fields like title, content, timestamp, and user association in the database schema.
T1.notes: Ensure proper indexing for fields that will be used in search functionality.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for CRUD operations on notes using a backend framework like Django or Express.
T2.notes: Include authentication and validation for secure access.

T3.implementation_approach: Create a responsive frontend page using a framework like React or Vue to display, create, edit, and delete notes.
T3.notes: Integrate the frontend with the API and ensure proper error handling.

T4.implementation_approach: Implement a search feature in the API using query parameters and optimize it with database indexing.
T4.notes: Add a search bar in the frontend to call the API and display filtered results.

T5.implementation_approach: Organize the project into separate folders for models, APIs, frontend, and configurations, and set up environment variables for sensitive data.
T5.notes: Use version control and document the structure for team collaboration.
